scope: Read-only Production NFL historical publication; no user, wallet, ownership or competition mutations
source: nfl_history.records joined to consumer.active, generations and mappings
identity: Display names come from nfl_history.players.payload.name; player joins use reviewed canonical mappings, not names.
limits: Raw record counts include positions outside Docked's supported offensive card catalogue. Mapped counts are not a claim that every field is complete or a round is final. Raw history has no per-record scoring_version; visible base points explicitly use the existing nflPlayerHistory Full-PPR reference version. Historical fantasy-entry scores retain their separately saved competition rules.
aflNrl: Existing config/history archives explicitly declare player_games=0 and player_statistics_available=false. Match results must not be presented as player fantasy scores.
